page_title: Inklane — Annotate and review in context
description: Draw a correction or pin a longer explanation directly to the source. Use Inklane in your browser or download the Windows app for images and printable PDF notebooks.
headline: Show exactly
hero_text: Draw a correction, mark a passage or pin an explanation to the spot you’re reviewing. Fold longer remarks away to see the whole page again.
sample_alt: A specimen sheet showing a purple coneflower and a detail of its seed head.
script_notice: Enable JavaScript to annotate the specimen in your browser.
local_note: Your files stay on this device. Save the editable marks or export feedback that identifies each marked spot.
desktop_text: Work through a folder of images or write directly on printable notebook pages. Search your pinned remarks and jump back to the places you marked.
unsigned: This installer is unsigned. Windows may show “Unknown publisher”.
signing_unknown: Publisher details are available in the release notes.
notebook_alt: Inklane on Windows showing a courtyard sketch and a searchable index of four anchored notes.
image_alt: A floor plan in the dark Windows workspace with pen marks and an expanded remark at the courtyard threshold.
try_intro: Try three small ways to make a point. Then take your own material into the workspace.
draw_body: Circle the doorway, trace a route, or sketch a change. Pick any color and draw on the plan.
draw_canvas: Draw on the plan. Delete removes the last stroke.
draw_caption: Draw with your mouse, finger or pen.
remark_body: A small pin holds a longer thought. Open it, change the explanation, then fold it away.
demo_remark: Compare the shape of the seed head with the drawing below. This detail helps identify the plant after flowering.
edit_body: Edit the words. Move the box by its grip. Drag its corner to change the line breaks. The text stays the same size.
demo_label: Make the entrance easier to find.
demo_move: Move text box. Arrow keys move it too.
demo_resize: Resize text box. Arrow keys resize it too.
edit_caption: Drag the handles, or focus one and use the arrow keys.
demo_ephemeral: These examples reset when you leave. Open the workspace to save your own editable documents.
workspace_intro: Explore a field guide with real editing tools. Open Inklane to work on your own files.
continuity_heading: Finish the thought. Keep the work.
continuity_intro: An editable original for you. A useful handoff for the person receiving your review.
editable_body: Save a portable workspace to keep the source and annotations together. Reopen it to change your marks.
handoff_body: Print a review with full remarks, export an annotated image, or send machine-readable feedback. Export options depend on the edition and source.
local_body: Start without an account. Files stay on your device. Keep a saved copy before clearing browser data or switching devices.
platform_intro: The browser workspace is available now. Native editions have different distribution and verification status.
platform_web: Open now · local files · offline after setup
platform_windows: Downloadable release candidate for Windows 11 x64
platform_native: Development build · source and build instructions
platform_apple: Development builds · no App Store release
